headline: FBI Investigates Cyberattack on US National Criminal Data System
summary: The FBI launched an investigation into a potential breach of its National Crime Information Center database. The system stores criminal records, missing persons files, and law enforcement intelligence.
why: Cyberattacks on major government databases raise national security concerns and spur federal cybersecurity defense spending.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Unauthorized intrusions into federal security databases raise critical infrastructure vulnerabilities.
